chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from Bukayr ibn Aʿyan, from one of the two of them عليهما السلام, who said:
If the state of hadath occurs in the masjid, then there is no harm in performing wudu (ablution) in the masjid.

key_terms.الْحَدَثُ: a state of ritual invalidation requiring purification
key_terms.الْمَسْجِدِ: the masjid, the place of worship where the ruling is applied
key_terms.الْوُضُوءِ: wudu (ablution), the ritual washing for taharah
key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform wudu in the masjid if hadath occurs there?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning ritual purity in the masjid. It states that if hadath occurs while one is in the masjid, there is no problem in performing wudu (ablution) there.
